regions.merged_text: Stanislaus Wierzbicki - 15 - Epileptic fits for 4 yrs, five & 6 times a week - some days 3 times. Was enrolled in Ser. Mass Assoc 'n last Thursday A.M. after spending all night (nearly) in convulsions. Has not had any fits since. They ask prayers in thanksgiving and that the cure may prove permanent - promises to enroll perpetually as soon as next pay-day comes.
